❓ Psychology Data Lifecycle Pre-Quiz

This pre-quiz contains 10 multiple-choice questions about the psychology data lifecycle and common random-variable concepts used in research.

  • What you will do: Read each question carefully and choose the best answer using the response buttons.
  • Purpose: This is a baseline check before instruction, so it should reflect what you already know rather than what you can memorize in the moment.
  • Timing: Questions remain available long enough for careful reading, and correct confirmations are brief at about 0.5 seconds.
  • Why it helps: The results highlight strengths, gaps, and misconceptions that can guide the rest of the unit.

Work steadily, choose the best answer for each item, and continue when you are ready.

Pre-Quiz Complete!
